newsitem.title: USA: Cablevision says interested in MSG stake.
newsitem.headline: Cablevision says interested in MSG stake.

text.p: Cablevision Systems Corp chief executive officer James Dolan said the company is interested in buying ITT Corp's 50 percent stake in Madison Square Garden.

"First they have to decide if they're really interested in selling it and I have no idea whether they are or not. If they are, then we're very interested in buying," Dolan told Reuters in a telephone interview.

Cablevision and ITT partnered in 1995 to buy the Madison Square Garden properties, which include the famous arena, the Knicks professional basketball team, the Rangers professional hockey team and the MSG television network.
ITT is expected to sell its stake in the Madison Square Garden properties as it defends itself against a hostile takeover bid from Hilton Hotels Corp.
ITT last week rejected Hilton's $6.5 billion offer and said it would consider selling non-core assets to focus on its Sheraton hotels and Caesars casino businesses.
